claims: Claim 1: forward source->target, integer mode, objective Equal, projection onto the 146,248 retained coordinates, inverse=1 (the opposing reverse Return must compose to the identity on every input coordinate).
Claim 2: reverse target->source, integer mode, objective Equal, inverse=0; Claim 3: reverse target->source, LP (non-integer) mode, objective Equal - one map serves both modes.

Domain contract: 1,664 source coordinates are removed and reconstruct as constant 0; every retained coordinate keeps its binary domain and objective coefficient; no feasibility, optimality or strictness assertion.
The Request must equal the certificate's claims exactly (6,354,119 B = 3 x 146,248 explicit projection pairs), so any claim edit has to be mirrored in both files.

agent_manual_work: Parsed the whole 2,310,785-line / 105.2 MB MPS by hand: 147,912 binary columns, 17,245 rows, 2,027,726 nonzeros; a strict 12-character numeric-field parse failed, so the widened-field dialect was validated record by record.

Found and replayed the forced-zero proof: 48 equations 2u-v=0 with u,v binary, then two propagation rounds ((1440,48) and (128,128)) over zero-RHS sign-definite rows -> 1,664 zeros in 224 steps; 12 empty rows turned out to have RHS 1, not 0.

Censused 1,032 uniform rows, grouped by exact support into 78 supports bounded by -8 lower and +8 upper rows, integer-rounded each to one cardinality (47x5, 24x4, 5x3, 2x2), and proved the 78 supports disjoint, covering 101,656 vars with total 350.

Rewrote the 8 dense fractional rows (whole 101,656-var support, two coefficient values) as b*350+(a-b)*sum(A) with directed rounding, checking all 351 integer cardinalities per row; matched 120 subset upper rows to containing cardinality equalities.

Wrote a second, independent strict-fixed-field parser to audit the 54,044,302 B artifact (every coefficient, sense, RHS, bound, marker) and recorded hashes/checks in output/verification.json; no solver was used.
friction: Two eval assertions failed on assumed dialect/facts: strict-12-char MPS fields (the file uses widened fields) and 'every empty row has RHS 0' (12 rows are 0<=1). Each needed a full re-scan to settle.

The certificate shape is fixed boilerplate: 46.1 MB (74.1%) is the identity map plus the domain/row Refs the checker itself enumerates from the models (docs/CURRENT_FORMAT.md:224-235), yet the caller must write every element.
No proof-construction API: the 60-line case file only assembles steps by hand (prepare_test56.py:14-30) on top of 950 lines imported from 6 sibling preparers.
The reformulation contract is untyped JSON re-read by string keys (audit.json 5.7 MB, 17 keys) with no schema binding its records to source rows/columns.
Index-space duplication: the preparer's row/column indices come from its own MPS text parse while every Ref in the RPA must address the kernel's canonical order; nothing checks the two agree.
